chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام instructed an elderly man, who had never performed hajj and was unable to undertake the hajj because of his old age, to equip a man to perform hajj on his behalf.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the Commander of the Faithful, Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا: an elderly man of advanced age
key_terms.يَحُجُّ عَنْهُ: to perform hajj on his behalf
key_terms.يُجَهِّزَ: to provide for or arrange the means for sending someone
key_terms.ٱلْحَجَّ: hajj, the pilgrimage to the Sacred House

ai.seo_question: Can an elderly person who is unable to perform hajj appoint someone to perform hajj on his behalf?
ai.summary: This hadith states that an elderly person who never performed hajj and is no longer able to do so due to old age should arrange for another man to perform hajj on his behalf. It reflects a jurisprudential ruling concerning deputizing for hajj when direct performance is no longer possible.
